name: Browserless MCP
tagline: Headless Chrome automation from your AI agent.
shortDescription: The Browserless MCP server. Run headless Chrome instances in the cloud, take screenshots, scrape rendered pages, generate PDFs, and run automated browser flows at scale.
longDescription:
## What it is

Browserless' MCP server. Exposes the Browserless cloud browser API as MCP tools: navigate to a URL, take screenshots, run JavaScript, generate PDFs, intercept network requests, and run multi-step browser flows.

## Why we recommend it

If you need real headless Chrome without managing the infra, Browserless is the canonical choice. It handles browser lifecycle, blocks ads/trackers, and scales to thousands of concurrent sessions.

## When to use it

- Visual testing: agent takes screenshots of pages across viewports
- PDF generation: agent renders a page to PDF
- Form automation: agent fills and submits a multi-step form
- Heavy scraping: agent uses a real browser to handle JS-rendered pages
installInstructions:
1. Sign up at https://www.browserless.io and get an API token
2. Set `BROWSERLESS_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @browserless/mcp`

**Self-hosted:** Docker image available for self-hosting.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Browserless: free tier with limited units. Pro from $50/month.
